name: pro-edition
description: Pro Edition: o painel que une Auto B-roll, Pro Captions, Podcast AutoCut e Auto Split. As ferramentas vindas de repos proprios moram em ferramentas/.

scripts.verify: npm --prefix ferramentas/auto-broll run verify && npm --prefix app run verify && npm --prefix ferramentas/pro-captions run verify && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.preparar: npm ci && npm --prefix ferramentas/auto-broll ci && npm --prefix ferramentas/pro-captions ci && npm --prefix app ci && node app/node_modules/electron/install.js
